name: M PURE (BIS)
summary: The M Pure RO Water Purifier delivers safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water with its advanced Reverse Osmosis (RO) purification system. Designed for brackish water, it effectively removes harmful impurities, excess TDS, bacteria, and viruses while retaining essential minerals.
intro: M PURE is a compact RO water purifier designed for brackish water. It features TFC membrane technology, multi-stage filtration, 9-litre storage, and a purification capacity of 12 LPH. With 50W power consumption and a convenient countertop design, it is ideal for reliable everyday drinking water purification.
